_comment: LIMIT-TEST CONTENT (2026-08-18): the kitchen-sink COOLDOWN - one effect of every type the cooldown fire path dispatches (sys.fireCooldown), EXCEPT recall, revive and tick_rate. Recall/revive carry activation preconditions (bound campfire anchor / corpse in range) that reject the WHOLE cast when unmet, which would make this skill refuse to fire in almost every test situation (PO ruling 2026-08-18; both stay covered by the shipped Recall/Revive). tick_rate is guardrail-frozen in BOTH directions for new player content (see landmine 5; covered by the shipped Haste). Cheat-only, godlike on purpose: SKILL OmniStrike; NO unlock source, ever - a test rig. LANDMINES this skill deliberately walks: (1) targetFactions is FORCED by calm+charm (factionScopedEffects) but the resolved mask is stamped on EVERY effect of the skill and gated in the one eligibility predicate all targeted effects share - so the list here names ALL ten mob factions PLUS 'aligned' (the player faction), or ally-targeted effects like instant_shield would silently reach nobody. (2) Effects resolve SEQUENTIALLY in authored order: detaunt is authored before taunt so the observable net state is taunted; dash is LAST so every query circle centers on where the cast happened, and the spawned Totem lands there too. (3) castTicks 30 makes this the second JSON skill with a cast (Revive is the other): cost + cooldown are consumed at cast COMPLETION, movement cancels for free, and castInterruptedByDamage stays false so combat testing does not interrupt it. (4) The up-front price is the SUM of all effects' costs (D8), rejected as one when unaffordable (D9). (5) tick_rate is ABSENT because both directions shift a cmd/aurad guardrail: a second haste (factor < 1) is modeled STACKED with Haste by TestAuraCostDrainIsSurvivableAtLevelOne (worstSustainableHaste multiplies factors, takes the worst duty), re-pricing the drain bound for every shipped aura - Heal fails first; a tick-slow (factor > 1) trips TestMaintainedBuffsNeverExpireOnATargetInRange, the deliberate tombstone for a real engine gap - maintained buffs (resist/slow/shield auras) live interval+1 at factor 1 while a slowed caster re-applies later than that, so every such buff in the game would flicker. Any new player tick_rate needs that design conversation first. All values [PLACEHOLDER] and irrelevant.
name: OmniStrike
description: Cheat-only test rig. Its calm breaks on any damage, its stun does not, a charm keeps the mob's own level and ends by turning on you, its leech follows whatever aura is on, and its reflect shares the hit as thrown.
